root_theory_intervals.activity: Current-source derivation, observer transport/feature redundancy analysis, synthetic mathematical checks, literature and agent synthesis

overhead_basis: Conservative20-minute allowance for orientation, coordination, record handling and tool overhead within the theory interval; final state/verification/commit closeout excluded entirely.

rcerc.scope: Exact controls, full-head influence, QR theorem, fitting-noise and grammar reviews

uniform.scope: Uniform/compression, partial controls, exact propagation/covariance cost
uniform.note: Final under2-minute wording correction excluded from theory credit.

current_shape.scope: Conditional shape, full cumulants, H3 product and late cost re-ranking

agent_time_note: Approximate active mathematical/source-analysis categories only; record/tool overhead and gaps between assignments excluded. These overlap root and each other, and do not multiply elapsed theory credit.
end_definition: Theory and record checkoff; final integrity verification, scoped commit and chat delivery follow, separately timestamped in VERIFICATION.json.
